presets.label: SSC CGL 2026 — Signature (historical cycle)
presets.note: JPG, 10–20 KB, about 6 × 2 cm. The application captures the photo live; use the official portal for that step.

presets.label: IBPS PO/MT XVI 2026 — Photo (historical cycle)
presets.note: Recent colour passport-style photo; live photo capture is also required in the application. 200 × 230 px is preferred.
presets.sourceTitle: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI detailed notification, Annexure III

presets.label: IBPS PO/MT XVI 2026 — Signature (historical cycle)
presets.note: Sign on white paper. The notice says 140 × 60 px is preferred; signature must be clearly visible and not in capital letters.
presets.sourceTitle: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI detailed notification, Annexure III

presets.label: IBPS PO/MT XVI 2026 — Left thumb impression (historical cycle)
presets.note: Black or blue ink on white paper. 240 × 240 px at 200 DPI (about 3 × 3 cm).
presets.sourceTitle: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI detailed notification, Annexure III

presets.label: IBPS PO/MT XVI 2026 — Handwritten declaration (historical cycle)
presets.note: Must be handwritten by the applicant in English, black ink, on white paper; not in capital letters. Follow the exact notice text.
presets.sourceTitle: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI detailed notification, Annexure III

presets.label: SSC CHSL 2025 — Signature (historical cycle)
presets.note: JPG, 10–20 KB, about 4 × 2 cm. The application captures the photo live; use the official portal for that step.
presets.sourceTitle: SSC Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination 2025 notice

presets.label: RRB Level 1 CEN 09/2025 — Signature (historical cycle)
presets.note: JPG/JPEG, 30–49 KB, at least 140 × 60 px. The candidate's own running signature in black ink on white paper; application photo is captured live.
presets.sourceTitle: RRB Centralised Employment Notification CEN 09/2025, sections 16.4–16.5.1
